title: 第813章 杀仙皇继续培养第812章 逃窜秒杀
slug: 全民宗主合成亿万傀儡
content_zh:
眨眼间便分出了胜负。
魔族五长老脑袋低垂，眼中已经没有了神采，脸上还残留一丝惊愕和难以置信。他胸口处的修为结晶已经消失不见，被皇隼一瞬间夺取后，将其中的神魂抹杀。
皇隼一转身返回，带着那一具残躯，连同修为结晶一起放到王海面前。
刷！
全部消失不见，被收入芥子空间内。
一切都是那么的迅速。
这就是实力上的碾压和偷袭之下的成果。
魔族五长老根本想不到王海在有几个王境大圆满战力护卫的情况下，还有一个皇境大圆满隐藏在暗处。
这是人族该有的战力吗？
死亡前的那一刻，他突然意识到这个实力低微的界主，原来是诱饵。
一击得手后，王海眼中满是兴奋。
皇境修为结晶！
要是积累到二十颗，能不能帮助皇境大圆满魂傀继续突破？
按照之前的规律，应该可以。
不过，他没有绝对的自信，必须要尝试之后才可以。
因为下一个境界，就是传闻中的仙帝境，在整个九天大世界中似乎都没有活跃的身影。
“皇隼一，继续！”
这碎石林中可不止魔族五长老一个仙皇境强者。
魔族联盟内的那几个皇族，听到他的行踪，肯定都会派遣狩猎队赶来，为了确保万无一失，能够从他身上获取人族的秘密，大概率也会派出仙皇境强者坐镇。
皇隼一的实力已经证明，他有能力在出其不意下秒杀皇境的实力。

然而，下一秒。
王海懵了。
碎石林上空，原本昏暗的天空，突然风起传出呜咽声，伴随着一片血雨落下。
原本混乱的碎石林立即安静下来，所有人都抬头看向天空，难以置信，满是惊愕。
“陨皇雨！！！”
“有皇境陨落！”
“嘶！谁？谁死了？”
“哪个皇境死了？谁杀的？”
“不好！快跑！”
一个皇境的陨落，让碎石林内的所有人醒悟过来，震惊之后，再也不敢相互攻击，全部都想尽快摆脱这片区域。
那落下的血红色陨皇雨，落到巨石之上，砸出一个个坑。
落在身上，如有千钧。
碎石林上空，凤族二长老和龙族长老聚在一起，满是惊愕的看向那空中，心中突然有些胆寒。
“是魔族的气息，哪一位长老陨落了？”
“应该是魔族五长老，我之前看到他了。”
沉默。
长时间的沉默。
魔族五长老是皇境中期，实力不俗，居然在极短时间内被击杀，连逃走和求救的机会都没有。
这意味着什么？
意味着敌人完全碾压了他。

此地居然有能斩杀皇境的战力，他们二人感到一阵胆寒，心中也开始害怕起来，打起了十二分精神。
下方的那片碎石林，也不敢轻易靠近。
content_en:
The winner was determined in the blink of an eye.
The fifth elder of the demon clan lowered his head, his eyes had lost their sparkle, and there was still a trace of shock and disbelief on his face. The cultivation crystal on his chest had disappeared. After being snatched by the Emperor Falcon in an instant, the soul in it was obliterated.
Huang Falcon turned around and returned, taking the broken body and placing it in front of Wang Hai along with the cultivation crystals.
brush!
All disappeared and were taken into the mustard space.
Everything is so fast.
This is the result of crushing strength and sneak attack.
The fifth elder of the demon clan never imagined that while Wang Hai was protected by several King-level Dzogchen warriors, there was also an Emperor-level Dzogchen hiding in the dark.
Is this the fighting power that the human race should have?
At the moment before his death, he suddenly realized that this lowly realm master was actually a bait.
After succeeding in one blow, Wang Hai's eyes were filled with excitement.
The crystallization of imperial realm cultivation!
If I accumulate twenty pieces, can I help the Imperial Realm Dzogchen Soul Puppet continue to break through?
According to the previous rules, it should be OK.
However, he does not have absolute confidence and must try it before he can do it.
Because the next realm is the rumored Immortal Emperor Realm, which seems to have no active figure in the entire Jiutian World.
"Emperor Falcon One, continue!"
There are more than just five elders of the Demon Clan in this gravel forest who are powerful in the Immortal Emperor Realm.
The royal families in the Demon Alliance will definitely send hunting teams when they hear his whereabouts. In order to ensure that they can obtain the secrets of the human race from him, they will most likely send out powerful Immortal Emperor Realm warriors to guard him.
Huang Junyi's strength has proven that he has the ability to kill the emperor's strength by surprise.
However, the next second.
Wang Hai was stunned.
Above the gravel forest, in the originally dark sky, the wind suddenly picked up and a whimpering sound was heard, followed by a rain of blood.
The originally chaotic gravel forest immediately fell silent, and everyone looked up to the sky, in disbelief and full of astonishment.
"Meteor Emperor Rain!!!"
"The emperor has fallen!"
"Hiss! Who? Who is dead?"
"Which emperor died? Who killed him?"
"No! Run!"
The fall of an emperor made everyone in the gravel forest wake up. After being shocked, they no longer dared to attack each other. They all wanted to get out of this area as soon as possible.
The blood-red meteorite rain fell on the boulders, creating craters.
When it falls on you, it feels like a huge disaster.
Above the gravel forest, the second elder of the Phoenix Clan and the elder of the Dragon Clan gathered together, looking into the sky in astonishment, feeling suddenly frightened in their hearts.
"It's the aura of the demon clan. Which elder has died?"
"It should be the fifth elder of the demon clan. I saw him before."
Silence.
There was a long silence.
The fifth elder of the Demon Clan, who was in the middle stage of the Imperial Realm and had considerable strength, was actually killed in a very short period of time, without even a chance to escape or seek help.
what does that mean?
It means that the enemy completely crushed him.
There was actually a fighting force that could kill the emperor here. The two of them felt a sense of fear, and they began to feel fear in their hearts, and they cheered up.
The gravel forest below did not dare to be easily approached.
